meta.title: What If Friction Disappeared for 5 Seconds? (TikTok 1080x1920)

captions.text: What if friction disappeared for 5 seconds?
You're walking home, eyes on your phone.
Your phone slides right out of your hand.
Walking only works because your shoes grip the ground.
Cars can't brake, steer or speed up.
The turning car keeps spinning… in a straight line.
It doesn't move. Nothing is pushing it.
Screws only hold because of friction.
They spin loose. Knots slip open.
Anything on a slope starts to slide.
Parked cars. Bins. All heading downhill.
Everyone is sliding. Nobody can stop.
And then friction comes back. All at once.
Every sliding car skids to a stop.
Would you survive 5 seconds without friction?
